meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目，找出没有被用到的代码（如未引用的函数、变量、导入），验证它们确实没用后，分批并行删除，每批独立提交，最后运行类型检查与构建，并汇报结果。
howto.when: 当你提到“remove dead code”、“dead code”、“cleanup”等关键词，或要求清理未使用代码时触发。

say.text: 删除这个项目里的死代码
say.note: Claude 会扫描全项目，验证后并行删除未使用代码。

say.text: 清理 src/utils.ts 文件里未使用的导入和变量
say.note: 只处理指定文件，其余不动。

say.text: 移除项目中所有未用到的导出函数和类型

howto.what_en: Claude will scan the project for unreferenced code (e.g., unused functions, variables, imports), verify with LSP that they are truly dead, then delete them in parallel batches with atomic commits. Afterward it runs typecheck and build, and reports the results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "remove dead code", "dead code", "cleanup", or ask to remove unused code.

say_en.text: Remove dead code from this project.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the whole project, verify, and delete unused code in parallel.

say_en.text: Clean up unused imports and variables in src/utils.ts.
say_en.note: Only the specified file is processed.

say_en.text: Remove all unused exported functions and types in the project.
say_en.note: It will confirm references before deleting.
